# Fitwell

- Keep the app dependency-free and mobile-first; the project is a static site in `index.html`.
- Preserve the supplied Fitwell dashboard visual language: blue navigation rail, white utility bar, compact cards, blue action buttons, and light gray page background.
- Keep the desktop layout close to the reference screenshot and stack the dashboard cleanly on iPhone widths.
- Dashboard actions should provide visible interaction feedback even before a backend is added.
- Do not reintroduce the previous exercise-coaching prototype unless explicitly requested.
- Serve the app with `ruby -run -e httpd . -p 4173 -b 0.0.0.0` from the project root.
